# Evaluation and backends

Low-level functions for evaluating configs, generating backend output and testing features programmatically.

## evaluate()

Evaluate a workspace: process each host's fragments and merge them.

```ts
evaluate(workspace: WorkspaceDef, options?: EvaluateOptions): EvaluatedHost[]
```

**`workspace`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inputs?` | `Record<string, InputDef>` | Flake inputs. Required (with `nixpkgs`) when the workspace has NixOS or nix-darwin hosts; optional for Windows-only workspaces. |
| `hosts` | `HostDef[]` | Every host, from `host()`. |

**`options`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `configDir?` | `string` | Directory containing winix.config.ts. Enables config-relative helpers such as `home.symlink("../nvim")` and WSL setup `repository: "self"`. |

## generateNix()

Generate Nix files from an evaluated workspace.

```ts
generateNix(workspace: WorkspaceDef, evaluatedHosts: EvaluatedHost[]): NixOutput
```

**`workspace`**: the same options as [evaluate()](#evaluate).

## generateWindows()

Generate Windows bundles for every Windows host in the evaluated workspace.
Non-Windows hosts are skipped.

```ts
generateWindows(evaluatedHosts: EvaluatedHost[], lock?: WindowsLock, configDir?: string, options?: GenerateWindowsOptions): WindowsOutput
```

**`lock`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | `1` | Lockfile format version (currently `1`). |
| `generatedAt?` | `string` | Legacy timestamp. No longer written: it changed on every resolution and caused merge conflicts between machines. Older lock files may carry it. |
| `packages` | `Record<string, WindowsLockPackage>` | Pinned winget package versions, keyed by package id. |
| `fonts?` | `Record<string, WindowsFontPin>` | Pinned font archives and hashes, keyed by font source. |
| `modules?` | `Record<string, WindowsLockModule>` | Source-qualified lowercase keys; legacy name-only entries remain readable. |
| `wslImages?` | `Record<string, WindowsLockWslImage>` | Pinned NixOS-WSL release images, keyed by architecture. |
| `wslRepositories?` | `Record<string, WindowsLockWslRepository>` | Pinned WSL setup repository commits, keyed by repository spec. |

**`options`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `presenceOnlyPackages?` | `ReadonlySet<string>` | Floating package ids whose installed version is not comparable (winget reports e.g. "Unknown"). They are emitted without `version`, so DSC only ensures presence instead of reinstalling the locked version on every run. |

## isWindowsHost()

True when an evaluated host targets the Windows backend.

```ts
isWindowsHost(host: { windows?: Record<string, unknown>; }): boolean
```

**`host`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `windows?` | `Record<string, unknown>` | Merged Windows options on the evaluated host. |

## withContext()

Run a callback with a synthetic evaluation context, for unit-testing
features and `.isActive` checks outside `evaluate()`. Restores the previous
context when `fn` finishes or throws.

```ts
withContext({ platform: "windows", features: ["dev"] }, () => {
  return platforms.windows.isActive;
});
```

```ts
withContext(ctx: { platform: string; variant?: string; hostname?: string; features?: string[]; configDir?: string; }, fn: () => R): R
```

**`ctx`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `platform` | `string` | Platform id, such as `"nixos"`, `"darwin"` or `"windows"`. |
| `variant?` | `string` | Platform variant, such as `"wsl"` for NixOS-WSL hosts. |
| `hostname?` | `string` | Hostname exposed to fragments. Defaults to `"test"`. |
| `features?` | `string[]` | Active feature and profile ids for `.isActive` checks. |
| `configDir?` | `string` | Directory containing `winix.config.ts`, for config-relative helpers. |
